The high scores in both paths (0.5291) suggest a strong predictive relationship, though the exact mechanism of action remains to be elucidated. The integration of these pathways highlights the potential for Acifluorfen to interact with SNU-387 through a common target, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm this relationship.
